figures.finding: Moldova's cash rebate, applied for through a Moldovan producer with a foreign partner, pays 25% of eligible spend in Moldova plus 5% where the film promotes a Moldovan place, with minimum spends of EUR 100,000 for a fiction feature, EUR 25,000 for a feature documentary and EUR 15,000 per series episode; the file goes in at least 25 working days before shooting.

value.name: Film in Moldova – Cash Rebate (National Center of Cinematography)
value.bonusCondition: thematic promotion of a Moldovan place
value.applicant: Moldovan producer with a cooperation contract with a foreign producer, 3 years' experience, cultural test

figures.applies: Moldova, foreign and co-productions, as published 2026.

sources.said: It shall be submitted at least 25 working days before the start of production Financial support amount? 25% - of the total eligible expenses incurred on the territory of the Republic of Moldova + 5% - conditioned by a thematic promotion, within the film, of the geographical area, locality or the entire Republic of Moldova.
Feature fiction film 100 000 euro … TV series (one episode) 15 000 euro … A feature documentary film 25 000 euro

figures.finding: The Ministry of Culture, through the National Center of Cinematography, funded 9 film projects with 13,298,368 lei in 2025 (13 with 9,632,359 lei in 2024); of 102 projects it backed from 2017 to 2024, 62 were finished, 50 released and 32 selected for international festivals. A new Cinema Fund under Law 240/2025 awaits its operating regulation.

value.fund: Centrul Național al Cinematografiei (Ministry of Culture); Fondul cinematografiei (Law 116/2014 as amended by Law 240/2025)

figures.applies: Moldova, Ministry of Culture note of April 2026 on the draft Cinema Fund regulation.

sources.said: În anul 2025 - bugetul a fost de 13 298 368 lei -9 proiecte cinematografice finanțate; În anul 2024 - 9 632 359 lei -13 proiecte finanțate;

În această perioadă, Ministerul Culturii a susținut financiar 102 proiecte cinematografice … Dintre acestea, 62 au fost finalizate, 50 au fost lansate, iar 32 au fost selectate la festivaluri internaționale.
Cu toate acestea, în absența unui cadru normativ aprobat, mecanismele de operare și distribuție a resurselor financiare rămân suspendate
În Republica Moldova, după anul 2000 au fost realizate 337 de filme.
